portfolio.welcome: Welcome to my portfolio. Here is an overview of my work and experience.
cv.intro: You can view or download my CV in PDF format.
about.p1: After several years working in translation and IT project management, I chose to move into development to realise a long-held passion. The transition happened naturally: I found the same rigor, attention to detail and the same pleasure in turning an idea into a practical, useful solution.
about.p2: What I love about code is the balance between logic and creativity. I always strive to optimise, to make things smoother, clearer and more efficient—without ever losing sight of the end-user experience. Satisfaction for me comes from a system that works well, cleanly, and genuinely simplifies people's lives.
about.p3: I place great value on kindness and respect in working relationships. I enjoy collaborating, sharing knowledge and learning from others. Curious, honest and determined, I believe in continuous improvement, both individual and collective—the kind that allows a team to progress together and build sustainable projects.
about.p4: Outside of coding, I find balance in sport and music: badminton, running, salsa and bachata punctuate my free time and fuel my daily energy.
projects.livret.title: Livret CDA
projects.livret.description: Web application to manage training sessions, users (profiles), skills and admin areas. It includes fixtures to populate data, controllers and Twig templates for the UI, as well as a PHPUnit test suite with coverage reports. The code is organised with Doctrine for persistence and includes generation/CI tooling.
projects.breakingcat.title: Breaking Cat
projects.breakingcat.description: Web mini-game accessible after authentication, with two game modes (Normal and Hardcore, the latter marked as inactive). The player starts a game and records their score, which feeds a leaderboard displayed on the homepage. The interface is responsive (Bootstrap) with a light/dark theme, and data (users/scores) are persisted in a MySQL database via PDO.
